# All Clutch & Brake Service

> Adelaide's only dedicated clutch and brake specialist. Serving South Australia since 1984.

All Clutch & Brake Service is a family-owned automotive repair workshop based in Adelaide, South Australia. We specialise exclusively in clutch replacements, brake repairs, flywheel machining, hydraulic rebuilding, and performance upgrades for passenger vehicles, 4WDs, and commercial vehicles. All work is performed in-house — no outsourcing.

## Services

- Clutch repair and replacement (manual and automatic)
- Brake pad, rotor, and calliper servicing
- Flywheel machining and resurfacing
- Dual-mass flywheel replacement
- Hydraulic clutch and brake system repairs
- Performance clutch and brake upgrades
- 4WD and commercial vehicle clutch and brake work
